subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "What is the time by your watch?" he said. "It is half past nine," I said. He said, "I want to go to the school. Would you accompany me, please?" "No, I am sorry," replied I.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech He asked me what the time was by my watch. I replied that it was half past nine. He said that he wanted to go to school. He asked me politely if I would accompany him. I replied in the negative and said that I was sorry.
